🚀 #Perplexity open-sourced SPACE (Sandboxed Platform for Agentic Code Execution): a sandbox platform that runs agent and user code in isolated #Firecracker microVMs #AIagents #opensource

🔐 Every sandbox gets its own VM and writable filesystem, created from a reusable template. Apps create sandboxes, run commands, stream output and manage lifecycles through a plain HTTP API with server-sent events, no SDK required

🧵👇
